rules.statement: An inclusive fee charged for professional services rendered by a veterinary hospital, which includes diet and medicine, is considered a book debt within the meaning of section 9 of the Prescription Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not suggest that professional skill is not required in a veterinary hospital, but in this case the veterinary surgeon admits he cannot say what part of the sum charged represents his own professional services. An inclusive fee has been charged for the benefit of the business carried on by the partnership, into which the fees for professional services have become merged. That inclusive fee, it is admitted, includes diet and medicine."
